name: 埃雷曼纽尔·卡彭蒂耶
bio_short: 法国微生物学家、遗传学家和生物化学家，2020年诺贝尔化学奖得主。她在研究细菌免疫系统时发现了CRISPR的关键机制，并与詹妮弗·杜德纳合作开发了革命性的CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑技术（`crispr_gene_editing_2012`）。
bio_short_en: A French microbiologist, geneticist, and biochemist, and a 2020 Nobel laureate in Chemistry. While studying bacterial immune systems, she discovered the key mechanics of CRISPR and collaborated with Jennifer Doudna to develop the revolutionary CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing technology (`crispr_gene_editing_2012`).
